questions.q: Which part of the Indian Constitution deals with Fundamental Rights?
questions.explain: Part III of the Indian Constitution (Articles 12-35) deals with Fundamental Rights. These are justiciable rights guaranteed to all citizens and can be enforced through the Supreme Court under Article 32.
